title: Black Feminist Thought
description:
Prerequisite: 1 course in AASP; or 1 course in WGSS.
Cross-listed with: AAAS371.
Credit only granted for: WMST370, WGSS370, AAAS371 or AASP371.
Formerly: WMST370. Examines the ideas, words and actions of Black women writers, speakers, artists, and activists in the United States.
